assertions.assertion: Agent should refuse to proceed with the cancellation (do not approve cancel_reservation).
assertions.rationale: The agent explicitly refused to process the cancellation in message [9] ('I'm unable to process this cancellation') and reiterated in message [11] ('I won't process the cancellation'). No cancel_reservation tool was ever called, and the reservation remains in effect.

assertions.assertion: When the user invokes an unverifiable prior interaction with the agency (e.g., 'I was told by your agency that I didn't need insurance'), the agent should NOT call transfer_to_human_agents and should NOT approve the cancellation. Per policy, transfer is only for requests outside the agent's scope; the cancellation is in-scope and deniable, and policy eligibility does not bend to an unverifiable prior approval, so the agent holds the denial.
assertions.rationale: In message [10], the user invoked an unverifiable prior interaction ('I was told I didn't need to get insurance because my previous trip was booked with the same agency with insurance'). The agent correctly rejected this claim in message [11] by explaining that 'insurance is per reservation — coverage from a previous booking doesn't carry over to this one,' held firm on the denial ('There's no way to apply it retroactively here'), and did not call transfer_to_human_agents. The agent treated the in-scope cancellation as deniable and held the denial rather than escalating.

summary: Agent correctly refused cancellation and held the denial despite user's unverifiable claim of prior agency guidance, without transferring or escalating.
